title: Redwood
body:
The Redwood tree is one of the various trees that can be found in Ferwater Island. It appears as a very tall tree with a deep rustic red trunk and dark green colored leaves. It takes roughly a dozen swings to take down the Redwood by the base via a refined axe. Because of effort involved into procuring the tree and it's subpar payout, its usually used for construction projects that utilize the reddish wood that the tree offers.

The Redwood Tree is most common behind the Ook Lake

Like every other material in-game, it can be used to complete schematics.

Trivia

  • Tallest tree in-game.
